translationRepairs: He also appointed Hanlin academician-in-chief Wugusun Buji to oversee the princely mansions, with concurrent duties as associate administrator of the Great Muxin princely establishment and chief inspector; inner clansman Hezhou to manage palace affairs, assisted by left deputy inspector Wanyan Asa and right deputy inspector Wendun Ali; minister of revenue Wanyan Zhuke as overall commander of the inner city's four sectors; censor-in-chief Peiman Ahudai as concurrent overall pacifier of army and people; and remonstrating censor and director of the close attendants bureau Wugusun Nushen, acting left and right bureau director of the branch secretariat, as concurrent administrator of palace affairs.

He also appointed Hanlin academician-in-chief Wugusun Buji to oversee the princely mansions; inner clansman Hezhou, associate administrator of the Great Muxin princely establishment and chief inspector, to manage palace affairs, assisted by left deputy inspector Wanyan Asa and right deputy inspector Wendun Ali; minister of revenue Wanyan Zhuke as overall commander of the inner city's four sectors; censor-in-chief Peiman Ahudai as concurrent overall pacifier of army and people; and remonstrating censor and director of the close attendants bureau Wugusun Nushen, acting left and right bureau director of the branch secretariat, as concurrent administrator of palace affairs.
s0018 pairs 提控諸王府 only with 烏古孫卜吉, then 同判大睦親府事兼都點檢內族合周管宮掖事 with 左副點檢…右副點檢…副之; the titles and deputies belong to Hezhou, not Buji, so the repair correctly reattaches them.
Lady of the State of Xing, inner attendant Gao You, capital resident Li Minwang, and others all died under the rod.
Lady of the State of Cheng, inner attendant Gao You, capital resident Li Minwang, and others all died under the rod.
s0104 has 郕國夫人; 郕 is Cheng, not Xing (邢), so replacing Xing with Cheng corrects a real name error without other changes.
Lady of the State of Xing, the inner attendant Gao You, the capital resident Li Minwang, and others all died under the cudgel.
Lady of the State of Cheng, the inner attendant Gao You, the capital resident Li Minwang, and others all died under the cudgel.
The same 郕國夫人 in s0104 requires Cheng in the literal as in the idiomatic; Xing is unsupported by the Chinese.

At dawn Boyuan and the others came in person to invite Cui Li to inspect the fire. Cui Li went with Yuan Xiu, Zhe Xiyan, and several horsemen and ordered all men in the capital aged fifteen to seventy to assemble on Taibao Street for roll call.

At dawn Boyuan and the others came in person to invite Cui Li to inspect the fire. Cui Li went with Yuan Xiu, Zhe Xiyan, and several horsemen and ordered all men in the capital aged fifteen to seventy to assemble on Taimiao Street for roll call.
s0128 writes 太廟街 (Ancestral Temple Street); Taibao would be 太保, so Taimiao Street is the accurate repair.

Whenever Qi saw that Li wished to seize another man's wife, he would surely send the husband far away; one day he sent Qi out of the capital; Qi took his wife with him—this happened again and again—and Li then wished to kill Qi.

Whenever Qi saw that Li wished to seize another man's wife, Li would surely send the husband far away; one day he sent Qi out of the capital; Qi took his wife with him—this happened again and again—and Li then wished to kill Qi.

In s0118, 一日差琦出京 cannot have Qi as agent, and 必差其夫遠出 shares that silent subject with Cui Li (立); the literal wrongly made Qi the sender, and naming Li as the agent of both 差 clauses fixes the attribution.
